purpose: Executable denominators for decoder, recovery-map, logical-fidelity, benchmark, and replay-certificate language.

decoder_certification_rows.decoder_object: Route-local recovery channel, decoder, reconstruction algorithm, benchmark certificate, logical-fidelity test, erasure-threshold test, or public replay certificate invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
decoder_certification_rows.denominator_rule: Declare the fixed carrier, direct-sum target algebra, dominant-block projectors, one common CPTP decoder, local decoder certification domain, noise/adversarial model, operational norm, state-domain quantifier, and replay protocol. For whole-code/OAQEC claims, compute the complementary defect delta_A=||Nhat-Nhat o P_{A'}||_diamond in diamond/cb norm with an arbitrary external reference, or give a complete-boundedness theorem and explicit code dimension for lifting a state-only bound. Use delta_A<=tau^2/4 for a sufficient target tau and retain worst-sector control. For REF-0735-like large codes, retain alpha-independent epsilon-sub-tr, epsilon_OD, and epsilon_iso,small separately. A decoder certified on normalized dominant blocks may use epsilon_common<=epsilon_block+2 epsilon-sub-tr/(1-epsilon_iso,small) on sector-diagonal inputs; a full-sector-only certificate owes transport and does not close coherent superpositions. Cross-size entrywise or unassisted residuals require a dimension-aware operational theorem.
decoder_certification_rows.residual_gap: Sector-diagonal routing can be sharp while reference-stable whole-code recovery remains open. The owned transpose-dephasing channel has state error O(1/d_code) but diamond defect approaching one and minimum recovery error approaching 1/4; therefore epsilon_OD or epsilon-sub-tr cannot be renamed a cb/diamond residual. Physical code/reference growth, a same-map external-reference proof, constants, dominant-block decoders, center/factor geometry, and backreaction remain required.
decoder_certification_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer code-subspace closure, logical-operator identity, entanglement-wedge closure, black-hole information solution, public-record closure, or ToE identification from a decoder or recovery certificate alone.
